show_title: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Team Ritholtz - The Wu Tang Clan of Finance - [Invest Like the Best, EP.52]
summary: In celebration of the one year anniversary of invest like the best, I asked Josh Brown, Mike Batnick, and Barry Ritholtz to join me for a hour, during which I spent more time laughing than asking ques This is a strategy that everyone should try, but very few do. This podcast is one hell of a discovery machine, and the first year was our warm up.
